acceptance_checks: A refused carry is present in mergegate-result.json blocking_reasons naming the failing proof step, so the loop can carry it into a repair packet.
A proven carry on a PR blocked for a missing guardian:approved label is disclosed without any claim that approval was carried.
The gate and guardian_approval_signal.py name the same carry refusal reason over the same repository state.
With --base-sync-carry omitted the gate emits no carry-shaped output.
non_goals: Re-anchoring step 9 to the merged base (amends SADR-0018)
Changes to shiki_sync_proof.py, shiki_guardian.py, workflow YAML, or mergegate_check.py argv
scope: In scripts/mergegate_check.py enforce_guardian_policy, read the GuardianApprovalResult carry fields the gate previously dropped: disclose a proven carry as a warning naming the head it was carried from, and route a refused carry's evaluator reason to blocking_reasons when the gate blocks (warnings when another source approved), skipping reasons already raised as blockers. Pin gate-vs-signal carry parity, including the base-drift shape measured on PR #338, in tests/test_guardian_carry_parity.py, and record the live-tip anchor and its decay in docs/agents/guardian-policy.md.
title: Disclose the base-sync carry outcome in the MergeGate policy check
